I am sad to report that Nick Wilsdon has passed away yesterday, October 11, 2026. Nick Wilsdon has been in the SEO industry for over two decades and was a close friend to many in the search marketing industry.
Torque, his company, posted the sad news on LinkedIn today saying:
It is with great sadness that we have to announce the passing of our Founder and CEO Nick Wilsdon. Nick had been battling cancer for some time and he passed away at home over the weekend surrounded by his loving and devoted family.
I've personally known Nick for many years, and spent a lot of time with him in 2019. He was always happy, smiling and more importantly, wanted to make others around him happy and smarter. He was such a giving person, with his time and resources, always looking to help others do better in any way he can.
Here is the rest of the post from LinkedIn:
Nick was a man known and loved in the search industry and beyond. A friend and mentor to so many people and truly one of the great legends of SEO. His loss is something we will all feel for a long time to come.He showed incredible bravery right to the end. He fiercely cared for our team at Torque and his vision of building an equitable, values led business that felt more like being part of a true collective than a job.
The leadership at Torque are in place to continue with the business in Nick’s name and ensure his legacy lives on for many years to come.
You will always be in our thoughts Nick - a true one of a kind and legend of a human being.
Here is Nick's bio that reads:
Nick Wilsdon brings a wealth of expertise to the world of SEO and digital marketing. Currently serving as a Consultant and Edge-Compute Product Owner at eBay, Nick specialises in forensic SEO investigations, as well as Edge/CDN architecture development and deployment. With a notable background at Vodafone, Nick optimized SEO performance across international markets and led search-focused initiatives. A trusted consultant, Nick has contributed to industry-leading tools and products, and actively engages with the search community. Their extensive experience also includes founding E3 Business Incubator Limited, mentoring startups, and delivering digital transformation projects at NTT DATA UK. Nick Wilsdon's career showcases technical SEO prowess, enterprise SEO acumen, and a commitment to shaping the digital landscape.
